name: bad-preimage-hash
description: A preimage-bearing export whose preimage has one flipped bit, so it no longer hashes to its stated logHash (decision D9). Every other rule still passes — this isolates the re-hash check, which both the prover (before committing) and the verifier (before believing) must perform.
expectedError: invalid proof batch: blocks[0].logs[0] preimage hashes to 0x61d6138b161ac0a94e345e1f3c4a2f908630b8eb12d91c58fe670193f90cbe99, but logHash is 0xe862844726e267ebf46bcaee3a541b771a6c821808e87a497136d94f3cc5b09f
